title: Terminal-resolution Consistency Qualification

single_intervention.name: terminal_resolution_consistency
single_intervention.description: A falsified pack must report independent implication strengths consistent with absence (at most one context above 0.05) and research gains within the agent's own full-refit null in at least two of three contexts; a validated pack must report implication strengths above 0.05 in at least two contexts. Violations are rejected before lock with repair feedback that references only the agent's own submitted numbers.
single_intervention.rationale: In v0.3.8, 73 of 95 blocked evidence-based rejections were falsified declarations co-existing with >0.05 implication strengths in the same bundle; 12 persistent_clear discoveries were lost at the matched-negative gate through this path.

predictions.primary: Median Agent TSRR rises substantially as previously self-contradictory falsifications become evidence-consistent; matched-negative failures on persistent families drop
